title: Library for fast mapping of Java records to native memory
summary: TypedMemory is a Java library that enables type-safe mapping of Java records to native memory regions, providing high-performance zero-copy access to off-heap memory while maintaining Java's type safety guarantees.
problem_solved: Eliminates performance overhead when frequently transferring data between JVM heap and native memory in high-performance Java applications.
why_valuable: Enables Java developers to work with native memory efficiently while preserving type safety, making it ideal for low-latency trading systems, game engines, and high-throughput data processing.
